description: Internal MCP HTTP server in Python for AI governance — Q&A, compliance tools, multi-source ingestion, vector search, and OIDC auth.

userStories.title: Bootstrap project with uv and module structure
userStories.description: As a platform engineer, I want the project bootstrapped with uv so that dependencies and the module layout are reproducible from day one.
acceptanceCriteria: `pyproject.toml` declares Python 3.12+, all direct deps via `uv add`, and `uv.lock` is committed
Source tree has `src/server/`, `src/domain/`, `src/adapters/`, `src/vector/`, `src/catalog/`, `src/config/` as empty packages
`src/config/settings.py` loads env vars via pydantic-settings with a working `.env.example`
`make install` runs `uv sync` cleanly
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add FastMCP HTTP server with /health endpoint
userStories.description: As a platform engineer, I want a running FastMCP HTTP server so that agents have a stable MCP endpoint to connect to.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/server/app.py` creates a FastMCP app with HTTP transport
GET `/health` returns `{"status": "ok", "version": "<app_version>"}` with HTTP 200
`main.py` starts the server via `uvicorn` using settings from config
`make dev` starts the server and `curl http://localhost:8000/health` returns 200
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Dockerfile and Docker Compose for server and Qdrant
userStories.description: As a platform engineer, I want Docker Compose to start the full stack so that local setup requires only one command.
acceptanceCriteria: `Dockerfile` builds the Python server image with `uv` and installs from lockfile
`docker-compose.yml` defines services: `server`, `qdrant`, and `embeddings` (placeholder image)
`docker compose up` starts all three services without errors
Server health endpoint is reachable from host after compose up
`.gitignore` excludes `qdrant_storage/`, `data/`, and other volume paths
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add catalog data models for libraries and versions
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want typed data models for approved libraries and versions so that compliance tools have a structured source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/catalog/models.py` defines `LibraryEntry` with fields: `name`, `version`, `status` (`approved`|`restricted`|`forbidden`), `reason`, `effective_date`, `updated_by`
Status field is a `Literal` or `Enum` — no free-form strings
Models are pydantic `BaseModel` subclasses
Unit tests cover model validation for each status value
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add catalog data models for code standards and guidelines
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want data models for coding standards so that Q&A and compliance tools reference a structured policy object.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/catalog/models.py` adds `StandardEntry` with fields: `id`, `domain`, `title`, `description`, `policy_version`, `effective_date`, `updated_by`
`CatalogRepository` interface in `src/catalog/repository.py` exposes `get_library(name, version)` and `get_standard(id)` returning `Optional[T]`
Unit tests cover repository lookups returning `None` for unknown entries
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Qdrant client adapter with upsert and search
userStories.description: As a platform engineer, I want a Qdrant adapter so that ingestion and retrieval use a single, testable interface.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/vector/qdrant_client.py` wraps `qdrant-client` with `upsert_chunks(collection, chunks)` and `search(collection, vector, filters, top_k)` methods
Collection is created automatically if it does not exist, using the configured vector size
Each chunk payload includes: `chunk_id`, `origin`, `source_type`, `version_ref`, `timestamp`, `domain`
Adapter is configurable via settings (host, port, collection name)
Unit tests mock the Qdrant client and verify upsert and search calls
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add embedding service client for self-hosted model
userStories.description: As a platform engineer, I want an HTTP client for the self-hosted embedding service so that all embedding calls are routed through a versioned, swappable interface.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/vector/embedding_client.py` exposes `embed(texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]` calling the configured self-hosted endpoint
Model name and endpoint URL come from settings; model name is stored in chunk metadata on every upsert
Client raises a typed `EmbeddingError` on non-200 responses
Unit tests mock HTTP calls and verify metadata is populated
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add chunking strategies per source type
userStories.description: As a platform engineer, I want configurable chunking so that different source formats produce quality chunks with consistent metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/vector/chunking.py` exposes `chunk_markdown(text, metadata)`, `chunk_text(text, metadata)` functions returning `list[Chunk]`
`Chunk` dataclass has: `chunk_id` (deterministic hash of content), `content`, `metadata`
Markdown chunker preserves section hierarchy in metadata (heading path)
Max chunk size and overlap are configurable via settings
Unit tests verify chunk count, `chunk_id` determinism, and metadata fields
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Markdown ingestion adapter
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to ingest Markdown files so that internal docs and standards written in Markdown are searchable.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/adapters/markdown_adapter.py` implements `MarkdownAdapter` with `ingest(path, metadata) -> list[Chunk]`
Section hierarchy (h1–h3) is reflected in chunk metadata as `heading_path`
Adapter attaches `origin`, `source_type='markdown'`, `version_ref`, `timestamp` to every chunk
Unit tests ingest a sample `.md` file and assert chunk count > 0 and metadata completeness
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add PDF ingestion adapter
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to ingest PDF files so that policy documents distributed as PDFs are indexed.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/adapters/pdf_adapter.py` implements `PDFAdapter` with `ingest(path, metadata) -> list[Chunk]`
Text is extracted per page; page number is stored in chunk metadata
Adapter attaches `source_type='pdf'` and standard metadata fields
Unit tests ingest a small test PDF and assert text is non-empty and metadata is set
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Git repository ingestion adapter
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to ingest documentation files from Git repositories so that repo-based standards are indexed with their commit reference.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/adapters/git_adapter.py` implements `GitAdapter` with `ingest(repo_path, ref, glob_pattern, metadata) -> list[Chunk]`
Adapter reads matching files at the given ref and delegates chunking to `MarkdownAdapter` or `chunk_text`
`version_ref` in metadata is set to the resolved commit SHA
Unit tests use a fixture git repo and assert `version_ref` is a 40-char SHA
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add web and Confluence export ingestion adapter
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to ingest HTML/Markdown exported from web pages or Confluence so that Confluence knowledge is searchable without a live crawler.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/adapters/web_adapter.py` implements `WebAdapter` with `ingest(path_or_url, metadata) -> list[Chunk]` supporting local HTML files and optionally fetching a URL
HTML is stripped to plain text; `source_type='web'` or `'confluence_export'` is set based on metadata hint
Unit tests ingest a local HTML fixture and assert non-empty text chunks
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add ingestion pipeline with incremental mode
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a unified ingestion pipeline so that any source type can be ingested or re-ingested with a single call that skips unchanged chunks.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/domain/ingest_pipeline.py` exposes `IngestPipeline.run(source, metadata, incremental=True)`
Incremental mode skips chunks whose `chunk_id` already exists in Qdrant with matching content hash
Per-item errors are caught, logged with `origin` and error cause, and pipeline continues
Pipeline returns a summary: `{ingested: int, skipped: int, errors: list}`
Integration test runs the pipeline against a sample Markdown file and asserts summary fields
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add search_governance MCP tool
userStories.description: As an AI agent, I want a natural language Q&A tool so that I can ask about approved libraries, versions, and coding patterns and get cited answers.
acceptanceCriteria: `search_governance(query: str, domain: str | None)` MCP tool is registered on the FastMCP app
Tool performs hybrid search on Qdrant and returns `{answer: str, cited_chunks: list[{chunk_id, origin, policy_version}], confidence: float, policy_date: str}`
When no evidence is found, returns `{found: false, message: 'insufficient evidence'}` — never hallucinates
Tool requires `query:read` scope (enforced even before auth middleware is wired — stub returns 403 if missing)
Unit tests cover found and not-found scenarios with mocked Qdrant
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add check_library_compliance MCP tool
userStories.description: As an AI agent, I want a library compliance tool so that I can validate whether a given package and version are approved.
acceptanceCriteria: `check_library_compliance(name: str, version: str)` MCP tool is registered
Returns `{status: 'compliant'|'warning'|'non_compliant', justification: str, cited_chunks: list[...], policy_version: str, effective_date: str}`
Checks both catalog and vector store; catalog takes precedence
Unknown library returns `warning` with explicit message, not an error
Requires `compliance:read` scope stub
Unit tests cover compliant, warning, and non-compliant cases
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

Retrieves relevant standard chunks via semantic search on `snippet`

userStories.title: Add OIDC JWT validation middleware
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I want JWT validation on every MCP request so that unauthenticated calls are rejected with an auditable error.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/auth/middleware.py` validates Bearer JWT against configured OIDC issuer (`/.well-known/openid-configuration`)
Expired, invalid-signature, or missing tokens return HTTP 401 with `{error: 'unauthorized', reason: '...'}`
Valid token payload (claims + scopes) is attached to request context
JWKS are fetched and cached; cache TTL is configurable via settings
Unit tests cover valid token, expired token, and missing token scenarios using mocked JWKS
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add RBAC scope enforcement per MCP tool
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I want each MCP tool to enforce its required scope so that clients without permission are explicitly rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/auth/rbac.py` exposes `require_scope(scope: str)` decorator/dependency used by each MCP tool
Missing scope returns HTTP 403 with `{error: 'forbidden', required_scope: '...'}`
Scope map: `search_governance` → `query:read`; compliance tools → `compliance:read`; ingestion → `ingestion:write`
Replace scope stubs from US-014–017 with the real enforcement
Unit tests assert each tool rejects requests missing its required scope
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
